## Visual decisions (for eyeballing)

1. **It's a card now, not a strip.** This is the "emanet" fix. It was full-bleed with a bare `border-top`, so its left/right edges lined up with nothing below it. It now insets 12px — the same figure `.pin-shelf` and `.chat-cmp` use — and header + row list form **one** bordered `--radius-md` box. Collapsed, the header is the whole card; expanded, `[aria-expanded='true']` drops its bottom edge and bottom corners so the two fuse, the same seam `.pin-shell.has-rows` makes with `.chat-cmp-card.is-shelved`. All three objects in the column now share one pair of vertical edges.
2. **`--radius-md` (9px), one step under the shelf's 12px** — deliberate. The tray floats above the composer; the shelf fuses to it. The size difference is what says so.
3. **Mono for machine-authored text.** Row name → `--font-mono` 11.5px (it's a command). Header prose stays UI font. `-row-meta` gained `tabular-nums`, so the per-second row clock no longer jitters the status word beside it — a small bug the old CSS had.
4. **Accent spent only on live-ness**: run marker, spinner, a running row's status word — the tray's analogue of the shelf's progress fill. A live tray also tints its own border `color-mix(accent 30%)`. Row **hover** no longer takes accent; the whole band highlights `--color-bg-tertiary` like every other hoverable chip.
5. **Hover-revealed affordances, with one exception I want you to check.** `Output` fades in on row hover / focus-within / focus-visible (the `.pin-chip-x` rule) because it duplicates clicking the row. **`Stop` never hides** — full strength, always. That asymmetry is on purpose: 07-25 was exactly the bug of a running shell with no reachable off switch, and an affordance you have to hunt for isn't an off switch. Both are now borderless mono `--radius-sm` chips instead of outlined pills.
6. **Narrow (470px)**, matching the shelf's own stage: paddings tighten, `Output` drops entirely (the row click is the same action, so nothing becomes unreachable), Stop and the status column stay.

Focus rings moved from `--color-border-focus` to `--color-accent` to match the composer and shelf. Placement in `ChatPane` unchanged — the mount order and each surface's reason for it are documented and not mine to move.
